sloka: एवं कुशलवौ नाम्ना तावुभौ यमजातकौ ।मत्कृताभ्यां च नामभ्यां ख्यातियुक्तौ भविष्यतः ।। ७.६६.९ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ kuśalavau nāmnā tāvubhau yamajātakau ।matkṛtābhyāṁ ca nāmabhyāṁ khyātiyuktau bhaviṣyataḥ ।। 7.66.9 ॥

translations.english: Thus, these two, born as twins, will be known by the names Kuśa and Lava, and will become renowned by these names given by me.
